key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:030E
name: stub_return_only
description: Consists only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use. It has one instruction and does no work.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:0312
name: call_with_flag_selected_arguments
description: Tests a global word: when it is zero it calls the shared routine with the pointer and a second offset value, otherwise with the pointer alone. It is called from five places.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:0332
name: pass_fixed_address_blitter_setup
description: Makes one call to the blitter copy setup routine, passing a single fixed global address, then returns.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:0340
name: load_byte_forward_if_nonzero
description: Loads one byte from the address held in the address register into a global word. It returns on a zero byte; otherwise it calls the shared routine with the pointer.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:0806
name: select_routine_set_flag_value
description: Clears a global flag and calls one of two routines depending on whether the byte after the pointer is zero. It then sets a global word to 4095 if the flag was raised.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:0832
name: set_global_value_if_flagged
description: Calls a shared routine that copies sixteen words into a table with their bytes swapped, then sets a global word to 4095 when the global flag is nonzero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:084E
name: run_frame_with_counted_entries
description: Calls two shared routines, one of which swaps the screen buffers and waits for vertical blank. If the flag is set it loops over a count read from the pointer, calling routines for each entry; if clear it spins forever.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:08C8
name: spin_forever_in_loop
description: Contains only an empty endless loop, so control never returns to its caller.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:0972
name: spin_forever_unreached_code
description: Contains only an empty endless loop, and nothing reaches it; the code sits in a gap that the disassembler decoded as code.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:098E
name: program_blitter_and_draw_entry
description: Fills two parameter blocks in global memory, calls the blitter setup routine for each, and waits for the blitter to finish. If the index read from the pointer is valid, it draws the selected entry twice with different size values.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:0ABA
name: stub_return_only
description: Consists only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use. It has one instruction and does no work.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:0ABC
name: draw_entry_unless_sentinel
description: Returns at once if the word at the pointer is the sentinel value. Otherwise, when the flag is clear, it looks up an offset from a table indexed by the word's low twelve bits and calls the shared routine with that offset plus a base and a width from the next byte.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:0B32
name: advance_script_to_matching_entry
description: Calls a shared routine three times, then optionally calls a hook through a function pointer. It scans a byte stream of three-byte records for one whose control byte matches the current flag bits, and stores the address that record refers to.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:0B52
name: find_script_entry_for_flags
description: Optionally calls a hook through a function pointer, then scans a byte stream of three-byte records for the first control byte that matches the current flag bits. It stores the address the record refers to, resolving negative values through a table.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:0B8C
name: scan_script_entries_from_start
description: Scans a byte stream of three-byte records, testing each control byte against the flag bits until one matches or the end marker is reached. On a match it stores the address the record refers to, resolving negative values through a table.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:0BA4
name: scan_entries_from_control_four
description: Scans a byte stream of three-byte records starting from the control value four, testing each control byte against the flag bits. On a match it stores the record's target address in a global, resolving negative values through a table.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:0BBC
name: scan_entries_from_control_eight
description: Scans a byte stream of three-byte records starting from the control value eight, testing each control byte against the flag bits. On a match it stores the record's target address in a global, resolving negative values through a table.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:0BD4
name: scan_entries_from_special_control
description: Scans a byte stream of three-byte records starting from the special control byte, skipping records whose flag bits are set. On a match it stores the record's target address in a global, resolving negative values through a table.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:0C04
name: resolve_script_entry_address
description: Reads the word at the pointer and stores its target address in a global; a negative word is first mapped through a table when a global counter matches. Otherwise it returns with no change.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:0C08
name: scan_entries_for_flag_one
description: Scans a byte stream of three-byte records for a control byte that matches flag bit one, then stores the record's target address in a global, resolving negative values through a table.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:0C0E
name: resolve_script_entry_word
description: Reads the word at the pointer and stores its target address in a global, resolving negative values through a table when a counter matches. It is the entry point used after a scan has already found the record.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:0C3C
name: resolve_indexed_script_address
description: Clears a global flag and stores in a global the address taken from a table at an index given by the low word of the data register, minus one, added to a base address.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:0C5A
name: store_base_plus_offset_address
description: Adds the data register value to two global base values and stores the sum in a global address variable.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:0C70
name: stub_return_only
description: Consists only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use. It has one instruction and does no work.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:0C72
name: program_blitter_four_blocks
description: Writes blitter parameter values for four consecutive blocks, advancing the source and destination pointers by 8000 bytes each time, and waits for the blitter to finish.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:0D4A
name: program_blitter_with_parameter_offset
description: Writes blitter size, modulo and pointer values derived from a parameter plus a fixed offset, runs four blitter transfers with pointer offsets, and waits for the blitter to finish.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:0EFE
name: program_blitter_two_parameter_offsets
description: Writes blitter pointer and size values derived from two parameters with fixed offsets, runs four blitter transfers, and waits for the blitter to finish.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1096
name: program_blitter_single_parameter_copy
description: Writes blitter parameter values from a single argument and runs four blitter transfers at fixed offsets. It does not wait for the blitter to finish in the code shown.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:10EA
name: set_blitter_registers_from_index
description: Writes blitter control and size values built from a 16-bit index, runs four transfers at fixed offsets, and waits for the blitter to finish.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:11AA
name: setup_interrupt_control_words
description: Writes an all-low-bits mask to two global control words, then sets one bit and clears another in a third word. It picks between two constant values based on a bit in a structure, and then stores a handler address.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1284
name: clear_pending_flag_and_report
description: Returns one and clears bit zero of a byte at a fixed offset from the base register when a global flag is nonzero; otherwise it returns zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:12EA
name: build_pointer_table_from_entries
description: Clears four state words, scans a 127-entry byte table, and fills a table of 30 block pointers spaced by a stride. It then sets a status flag.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:12EE
name: build_pointer_table_and_flag
description: Clears four state words, scans a 127-entry byte table, and fills a table of 30 block pointers spaced by a stride, then sets a status flag. The visible code matches the preceding table builder.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:13A0
name: restart_audio_channels_after_delay
description: When a global flag is set, it counts a frame counter and, on the final count, waits in a timed delay loop, sets the DMA enable bits and reloads the four audio channel location registers from saved globals. Otherwise it runs an alternate path with the same reload step.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:13D2
name: advance_sound_sequence_index
description: While a global flag is set, it converts a byte into a timing value, clears the flag, and advances a 7-bit index that wraps when it reaches the count stored in a table.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:13D8
name: derive_audio_channel_period
description: Derives a playback period for an audio channel from a 12-bit period field and an effect nibble, using frame-based choices or a search in a period table. The result is written to the channel's audio register.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1410
name: enable_audio_dma_reload_channels
description: Waits in a timed delay, sets the DMA enable bits, and reloads the four audio channel pointer registers from saved globals. It also advances a 16-step timing counter and resets the sound sequence index at its end.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1470
name: load_channel_sequence_note
description: Loads the next note from a channel's sequence record, selects a sample pointer, volume and period from tables when the record is not empty, and stores them in the channel state.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:14FC
name: apply_channel_effect_nibble
description: Stores the channel's offset and volume, then applies its effect nibble. Some effects call helpers that adjust the stored period, and nonzero periods are looked up in a table.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1552
name: lookup_channel_period_entry
description: Searches a 36-entry period table for the first entry not below the channel's period and stores the match in the channel state. It also copies the sample pointer and length into the hardware-side record and clears two flags for other effects.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1558
name: dispatch_channel_effect_value
description: Selects an action from the effect nibble: advancing a sample pointer, a position jump, or a volume set capped at 63. It returns a computed value and writes it to global state.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1560
name: enable_channel_dma_with_effect
description: Looks up a period for the channel, stores the sample pointer and length, applies the channel effect, and writes the DMA control register to enable the channel.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:15E4
name: enable_audio_dma_reload_channels
description: Waits in a timed delay, sets the DMA enable bits, and reloads the four audio channel pointer registers from saved globals. It advances a 16-step timing counter and resets the sound sequence index when it reaches its end.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:16FE
name: update_channel_value_from_table
description: Stores the channel's current value, then when the effect nibble is set picks a replacement from a per-channel table, chosen by the frame counter modulo three. The result is written back to the channel state.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1766
name: copy_channel_period_value
description: Copies a 16-bit period value from one channel record to a field in another record.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:176E
name: lookup_channel_period_value
description: Selects a 16-bit period either directly from the stored value, when the frame counter modulo three is zero, or from a per-channel table indexed by a nibble. The result is written to the channel record.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1790
name: find_period_table_entry
description: Scans a 36-entry period table for the first entry at or above the channel's period, then copies the entry chosen by the low nibble into the channel record.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:179C
name: store_channel_period_word
description: Copies a 16-bit period value from one channel record to a field in another record.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:17A2
name: scan_period_table_with_index
description: Scans a 36-entry period table for the first entry not below the channel's period, then copies the entry at the index held in the data register into the channel record.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:17CC
name: store_data_register_word
description: Stores the 16-bit value held in the data register into a field of the channel record.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:17D2
name: slide_channel_period_down
description: When a global flag is clear, subtracts the low nibble from the channel's period, floors the 12-bit result at 113, and writes it to the channel record.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1820
name: slide_channel_period_up
description: When a global flag is clear, adds the low nibble to the channel's period, caps the 12-bit result at 856, and writes it to the channel record.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1870
name: select_table_entry_toward_target
description: Finds the first table entry above the channel's current value, stepping back one entry when a flag bit is set. It stores that entry in the channel record and sets a flag when it is below the target value.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:18CC
name: clear_channel_slide_target
description: Sets the slide target field in the channel record to zero.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:18D2
name: apply_channel_slide_step
description: Adds or subtracts the step byte from the period field, depending on the slide direction, and clamps it to the target when reached. It then returns a value derived from the period.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:18E0
name: apply_slide_return_mask
description: Adds or subtracts a step from the period field toward a target and clamps it when reached. It returns a value combining the effect byte with the result.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:190E
name: decrement_channel_period_and_lookup
description: Subtracts the input value from the channel period and clamps it to the target when reached. When the low nibble of the effect byte is set, it finds the nearest table entry and stores the result in the channel record.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1960
name: compute_modulated_channel_period
description: Updates a packed nibble control byte from the parameter, then computes an oscillating offset from a table or a computed ramp. It scales the offset by a depth nibble and adds it to the base value in the channel record.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:198A
name: apply_channel_modulation_step
description: Computes an oscillating offset as the preceding routine does, writes the base plus offset to the channel record, and advances the phase by a rate nibble.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:19B2
name: apply_modulation_offset_from_input
description: Negates the input when the phase is negative, scales it by a depth nibble, and writes the result plus the base value to the channel record. It then advances the phase.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:19C0
name: apply_modulation_offset_from_byte
description: Scales a byte by a depth nibble, applies the sign from the phase, and writes the result plus the base value to the channel record. It then advances the phase.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:19C4
name: apply_modulation_offset_from_table
description: Reads a byte from a table at the given index, scales it by a depth nibble, and writes the result plus the base value to the channel record. It then advances the phase.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:19E2
name: store_input_difference_value
description: Writes the difference of two 16-bit inputs to the channel record and advances the phase counter by a rate nibble.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:19F8
name: adjust_channel_volume_by_nibble
description: Calls a helper, then raises the channel volume by the high nibble of the parameter, capped at 64, or lowers it by the low nibble, floored at zero. The result is stored in the channel record.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1A00
name: adjust_channel_volume_by_nibble
description: Calls a helper, then raises the channel volume by the high nibble of the parameter, capped at 64, or lowers it by the low nibble, floored at zero. The result is stored in the channel record.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1A06
name: compute_clamped_volume_envelope
description: Updates a packed nibble byte from the parameter, selects a table or ramp value, and scales it by a depth nibble. It adds a base volume and writes the result, clamped between zero and 64, to the channel record.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1A5A
name: apply_clamped_volume_offset
description: Negates the input when the phase is negative, scales it by a depth nibble, adds a base value, and clamps the result between zero and 64 before writing it to the channel record. It then advances the phase.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1A68
name: apply_clamped_volume_from_byte
description: Scales a byte by a depth nibble, adds a base value, and clamps the result between zero and 64 before writing it to the channel record. It then advances the phase.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1A6C
name: apply_clamped_volume_from_table
description: Looks up a value from a table at the given index, scales it by a depth nibble, adds a base value and clamps the result between zero and 64 before writing it to the channel record. It then advances the phase.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1A8C
name: clamp_difference_to_volume_range
description: Clamps the difference of two inputs to the range zero to 64, stores it in the channel record, and advances the phase.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1AB0
name: step_channel_accumulator_by_rate
description: Keeps the packed rate byte when it is nonzero. While the scaled rate fits in the counter, it subtracts the rate from the counter and adds it to the accumulator; otherwise it resets the counter to one.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1AD4
name: reset_channel_counter_to_one
description: Sets a 16-bit counter field in the channel record to one.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1ADC
name: adjust_channel_volume_by_nibble
description: Raises the channel volume by the high nibble of the parameter, capped at 64, or lowers it by the low nibble, floored at zero. The result is stored in the channel record.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1B04
name: subtract_low_nibble_from_volume
description: Subtracts the low nibble of the parameter from the channel volume, floored at zero, and stores the result in the channel record.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1B22
name: store_parameter_minus_one
description: Stores the parameter byte minus one in a global variable, then writes zero and 255 to global variables.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1B3C
name: clamp_parameter_to_volume_max
description: Clamps the parameter byte to a maximum of 64, stores it in the channel volume field, and writes it to the channel record.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1B54
name: compute_packed_nibble_value
description: Computes the high nibble times ten plus the low nibble of the parameter and stores the result in a global. A global flag is then set depending on whether the value is below 64.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1B7C
name: set_divided_tempo_value
description: When the parameter is zero, clears several global variables and returns. Otherwise it clamps the parameter to a minimum of 32, divides a global value by it, and stores the low and high bytes of the quotient in two channel tables.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1B9C
name: apply_effect_slide_or_jump
description: Handles effect nibble nine by advancing a sample offset in steps of 128 and handles other effect nibbles through helper calls. It returns the computed offset.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1BD6
name: run_channel_effect_state_machine
description: Dispatches on the high nibble of the parameter: zero updates a global mask bit, and one counts down a channel period by the low nibble, clamped at 113. Other codes call several helper routines.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1C52
name: set_flag_bit_from_parameter
description: Sets bit one of a global control byte to the low bit of the parameter, leaving its other bits unchanged.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1C6C
name: store_low_nibble_channel_control
description: Replaces the low nibble of a control byte in the channel record with the low nibble of the parameter byte.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1C80
name: store_low_nibble_channel_state
description: Replaces the low nibble of a state byte in the channel record with the low nibble of the parameter byte.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1C94
name: store_parameter_low_nibble
description: Stores the low nibble of the parameter byte into a byte field of the channel record.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1CA2
name: run_channel_repeat_counter
description: While the global flag is clear, a nonzero low nibble arms or decrements a repeat counter and outputs a stored value while it runs. A zero nibble records a timing value from the global counter's high nibble.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1CD4
name: set_channel_repeat_count
description: Stores the parameter byte as the channel's repeat count, then writes the channel's stored value and a flag to globals.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1CDA
name: record_timing_high_nibble
description: Stores the high nibble of a 16-bit global timing value into a byte field of the channel record.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1CE6
name: store_param_high_nibble_state
description: Keeps the low nibble of a state byte in the channel record and replaces its high nibble with the low nibble of the parameter byte.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1CFC
name: start_channel_dma_on_interval
description: When the low nibble of the parameter is nonzero and the global counter is a multiple of it, copies two pointer values to the audio registers, writes the channel's DMA enable bits after a short delay, and reloads the channel pointers.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1D66
name: raise_channel_volume_by_nibble
description: When a global flag is clear, adds the low nibble of the parameter to the channel volume, caps it at 64, and writes it to the channel record.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1D7E
name: lower_channel_volume_by_nibble
description: When a global flag is clear, subtracts the low nibble of the parameter from the channel volume, floored at zero, and writes it to the channel record.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1D96
name: reset_channel_when_nibble_matches
description: If the low nibble of the parameter equals a global value, clears a byte field and a word field of the channel record. Otherwise it returns without change.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1DB4
name: trigger_channel_dma_on_match
description: When the low nibble of the parameter equals a global value and the record's count is nonzero, copies two pointer values to the audio registers. It writes the DMA enable bits after a short delay and then reloads the pointers.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1DD4
name: arm_counter_nibble_plus_one
description: When two global flags are both clear, stores the low nibble of the parameter plus one in a global counter.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:1DFC
name: advance_channel_sequence_pointer
description: When a global flag is clear, stores the high nibble of the parameter in a control byte. When the accumulator's top bit is set after adding a table value, it resets the accumulator and advances the sequence pointer, wrapping at the end.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:2664
name: draw_bitplane_rows_count_8
description: Copies source bytes into bitplane buffers with shifts and masks over a row count of 8, choosing its source setup from a global mode value. It writes to the destination planes.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:26CC
name: draw_shifted_bitplane_span
description: Computes a word offset from the high nibble of a value, then shifts source bitplane words by a bit offset before writing them to the destination planes.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:2726
name: copy_shifted_bitplane_row
description: Writes a row of source words into a destination bitplane, shifting each word by an offset derived from a position value. It then stores the updated word index.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:285A
name: convert_chunky_to_planar_bytes
description: Converts groups of four source bytes into one byte in each of four destination planes, advancing the destination by a row stride.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:2888
name: write_masked_indices_to_planes
description: Reads four lookup-table indices per iteration and writes them into four destination bitplanes. The mask ensures that only masked pixels change.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:2902
name: copy_shifted_planar_bits
description: Shifts groups of source bytes by a bit offset and combines them with destination bytes in a loop. It returns early when a global flag is set.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:29D2
name: copy_shifted_bits_from_table
description: Looks up each source byte through a table, shifts the result by a bit offset, and writes it into the bitplanes. Its loop structure matches the neighbouring shifted copy routine.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:2AA8
name: draw_bitplane_rows_count_16
description: Copies source bytes into bitplane buffers with shifts and masks over a row count of 16, choosing its source setup from a global mode value.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:2ACC
name: draw_bitplane_rows_count_24
description: Copies source bytes into bitplane buffers with shifts and masks over a row count of 24, choosing its source setup from a global mode value.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:2AEC
name: draw_bitplane_rows_count_one
description: Sets a row count of one and a fixed source code value, then copies bitplane rows with the same shifts and masks as its neighbours.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:2AF0
name: draw_bitplane_rows_count_32
description: Copies source bytes into bitplane buffers with shifts and masks over a row count of 32, choosing its source setup from a global mode value.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:2B64
name: forward_call_and_return_registers
description: Calls a shared routine and returns the two 32-bit register values it was given unchanged.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:2B8C
name: forward_call_and_return_pair
description: Calls a shared routine and returns the register pair unchanged as one 64-bit value.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:2BB4
name: verify_opcode_word_or_patch
description: Compares a table word against a fixed opcode value. When they differ it writes an invalid marker and a return opcode into memory and returns that opcode; otherwise it sets a global from a masked value and returns minus one.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:2BE6
name: store_routine_result_minus_three
description: Calls a shared routine, masks its 16-bit result with seven, subtracts three, and stores the result in a global variable. It returns minus one.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:2BFE
name: blend_masked_bitplane_rows
description: Combines source rows with a mask into bitplane words in a loop, with a separate path when a global flag is set.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:2C34
name: blend_shifted_bitplane_rows
description: Processes rows of bitplane data with masks and shifts, writing the results to several destination planes.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:2C72
name: draw_shifted_masked_sprite_rows
description: Walks a list of source words and draws each segment into the bitplane buffers with shifts and masks, using helper calls for each segment.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:2DE0
name: unpack_table_into_bitplane_words
description: Reads source bytes through a lookup table, combines several looked-up values into 16-bit words, and writes them into bitplane buffers in a loop.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:2F0A
name: blit_masked_plane_words
description: Combines source words with existing bitplane contents using masks and shifts. A separate loop runs when a global flag is set, and the results are written back.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:309C
name: copy_shifted_words_to_planes
description: Reads a sequence of source words, applies a bit shift, and writes the results to destination words in several planes.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:315A
name: merge_masked_plane_sequence
description: Merges a sequence of source bytes into planar destination words, combining them with masks and shifts in a loop.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:3348
name: rotate_table_value_into_planes
description: Reads values from a table, rotates the bits of each by a shift count, and writes them to the planes.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:3420
name: wrap_drawing_call_with_offsets
description: Sets up address and count values and calls a shared drawing routine once, then returns.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:3442
name: call_drawing_routine_with_counts
description: Sets up address and count values and calls a shared drawing routine once, then returns.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:3466
name: call_drawing_routine_with_offsets
description: Sets up address and count values and calls a shared drawing routine once, then returns.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:348A
name: forward_call_and_return_pair
description: Calls a shared routine and returns the register pair unchanged as one 64-bit value.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:34B2
name: forward_call_and_return_pair
description: Calls a shared routine and returns the register pair unchanged as one 64-bit value.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:34DA
name: forward_call_and_return_pair
description: Calls a shared routine and returns the register pair unchanged as one 64-bit value.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:3502
name: forward_call_and_return_pair
description: Calls a shared routine and returns the register pair unchanged as one 64-bit value.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:3854
name: copy_four_row_plane_block
description: Copies a block of four rows of longwords from a source plane into a destination plane, with the destination offset taken from the input.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:38A2
name: combine_planes_into_masked_rows
description: Combines bits from several bitplanes into a mask buffer, then clears and writes the masked bits into the destination planes for a block of rows.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:3F74
name: copy_plane_block_from_struct
description: Copies four rows of longwords between planes like its neighbour, but reads the source and destination offsets from a record pointed to by an address register.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:405C
name: stub_return_only
description: Consists only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use. It has one instruction and does no work.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:flashback:2:43AA
name: setup_cutscene_blitter_frame
description: Clears several global state words, runs setup helpers, and programs the blitter registers for a frame. It then calls a handler through a counter-controlled step.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:endrun:0:0000
name: open_system_libraries_at_start
description: Entry point that calls the exec OpenLibrary function twice, for the dos and intuition libraries. When both opens succeed it sets up the process structure.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:endrun:0:0040
name: stub_return_only
description: Consists only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use. It has one instruction and does no work.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:endrun:0:0042
name: spin_forever_in_loop
description: Contains only an empty endless loop, so control never returns to its caller.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 1 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 1 of 4).adf:endrun:0:0044
name: clear_slot_call_library_function
description: When the argument is nonzero, clears a slot record and sets two words to all-ones, then calls an operating-system library function. The wider routine also writes the DMA control register and calls several library functions.

key: flashback (1992)(u. s. gold)(de)(disk 2 of 4)/Flashback (1992)(U. S. Gold)(De)(Disk 2 of 4).adf:bootblock:0:000C
name: run_boot_library_check
description: Boot-block entry that calls one operating-system library function and returns minus one when it yields zero, otherwise zero. Its text references the dos library name.
